### Potential Analysis

Cross-ref NYT bestsellers to prizes data: what trends or patterns seem to distinguish bestsellers that also win awards vs. bestsellers that don't (and prize-winners that aren't bestsellers)

Cross-ref NYT bestsellers to International Bestsellers data: to what extent

```{r}
weeks_df <- read_csv(here("data/post45_books/nyt_hardcover_fiction_bestsellers-lists.csv"))

titles_df <- read_csv(here("data/post45_books/nyt_hardcover_fiction_bestsellers-titles.csv"))

hathi_df <- read_csv(here("data/post45_books/nyt_hardcover_fiction_bestsellers-hathitrust_metadata.csv"))
```

## Exploring Potential for Linking / Merging

Merging / Joining = joining datasets. Easiest way to do this is to join them by a unique identifier.

Linking = adding unique identifiers to a dataset to enable cross-referencing or merging with other data

```{r}
print(dim(weeks_df))
summary(weeks_df)
```

```{r}
library(skimr)
weeks_df |>
    skim()
```

```{r}
weeks_df |>
    count(is.na(oclc_isbn))
```

```{r}
weeks_df |>
    count(is.na(author_wikidata))
```

```{r}

    skim()
```

```{r}
titles_df |>
    count(is.na(author_wikidata))
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
titles_df |>
    count(is.na(oclc_isbn), year)
```

```{r}
ggplot(titles_df |> mutate(has_isbn = !is.na(oclc_isbn)), aes(x=year)) +
    geom_bar(stat="count")
```

```{r}
books_summary <- titles_df %>%
    mutate(has_isbn = !is.na(oclc_isbn) & oclc_isbn != "") %>%
    group_by(year, has_isbn) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)

ggplot(books_summary, aes(x = factor(year), y = pct, fill = has_isbn)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack") +
    labs(
        x = "Year",
        y = "Percent of books",
        fill = "Has ISBN",
        title = "Percent of books with an ISBN by year"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#009E73", "FALSE" = "#D55E00")) +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
hathi_df |>
    skim()
```

```{r}
dupes_1 <- titles_df |>
    add_count(oclc_owi, name = "n_owi") |>
    filter(n_owi > 1) |>
    arrange(oclc_owi)
```
